# Plugin API reference

Plugin API version **1**. Everything here is written by `cargo xtask gen-docs` from the code itself: the samples of every contract type in `crates/swifty-plugin-api`, its doc comments, the hub's table of standard actions in `crates/swifty-hub/src/catalog/actions.rs`, and every manifest under `plugins/`. CI runs `cargo xtask gen-docs --check`, which fails when these pages and the code disagree. To change a page, change the code and run `cargo xtask gen-docs`.

The rustdoc of `swifty-plugin-api` (`cargo doc -p swifty-plugin-api --open`) is the API reference for the Rust side. These pages add the wire form of every value, the catalog, and what the hub does with what a plugin returns.

| Page | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| [capabilities.md](capabilities.md) | Device classes, capabilities, every standard action with its operation, tier and how it is confirmed, and the floors for custom actions |
| [ops.md](ops.md) | Every `Op` variant: its fields, its JSON, which actions send it, and when it counts as done |
| [states.md](states.md) | Every `State` variant: its fields, its JSON, and the class that reports it |
| [manifest.md](manifest.md) | Every manifest field, `Reach`, `NetUse`, `FieldKind`, `SecretSlot`, `CustomAction`, `Expect` |
| [setup-steps.md](setup-steps.md) | Every setup step, field type and input, with its JSON and how the app and the terminal draw it |
| [errors.md](errors.md) | `DeviceError`, `PluginError`, `ConfigProblem`, `Readiness`, `Health`, and what the hub does with each |
